name: Anthropic AI for Science — Hardware-Splicer Physical-Agent Study

fields.project_title: Evidence-Constrained Multimodal Agents for Reproducible Physical Engineering Experiments

packet_requirements.description: Prepared future proposal skeleton covering aims, Claude's experimental role, outputs, budget method and data/IP/participation guardrails.
At least one artifact-backed live external-model run on the unchanged corpus.
At least one fresh revision-bound physical case with measurement and failure/repair lineage.
Re-read current age/residency/jurisdiction, sanctions/export-control and eligibility rules for the actual applicant before promotion from HOLD.
Document a clean corpus/data/IP rights boundary and obtain any institutional consent required by current program rules.
Fix the applicant/organization/account that would receive credits and confirm its terms before submission.
Review current publicity/release and research-survey/interview obligations before accepting a selected-researcher position.

compliance_checks: Do not fire solely because the maximum credit award is large.
Do not treat 'any researcher may apply' as overriding the official jurisdiction, sanctions/export-control, rights or institutional-consent rules.
Do not include confidential professor/partner/industry data without explicit authority under the then-current program terms.
Do not claim external-model or fresh physical results before artifacts exist.
Derive the requested credit amount from the actual scientific workload rather than automatically requesting US$50,000.
